# Font licences

`glyphs.json` holds outlines of letters taken from these fonts. They are used only to draw text as shapes; the font files themselves are not included.

- Oxanium, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono: SIL Open Font License 1.1
- DejaVu Sans Mono (fallback glyphs only): free licence, see https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html

SIL Open Font License 1.1: https://openfontlicense.org
